_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Eco eggs in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs and https://github.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd (MIT).
name: Eco
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The ecosystem game where players build a civilisation together without destroying the world it depends on. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ -n "$SLG_TOKEN" ]; then exec ./EcoServer -userToken="$SLG_TOKEN"; else echo "No server token is set, so the server starts offline: it isn't listed and players' accounts aren't checked. Set Server token (from play.eco, Account, Server Authentication) to fix it."; exec ./EcoServer -offline; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Eco. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 739590) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. The world (Storage), mods and Configs are
# never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-739590}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The settings files start from the game's templates; the Panel sets the
# name, ports, passwords and listing in Network.eco and the language in
# Localization.eco at every start, and the rest is the owner's.
for f in Network Localization; do
    [ -f "Configs/$f.eco" ] || cp "Configs/$f.eco.template" "Configs/$f.eco"
done
chmod +x EcoServer
echo "Installed Eco build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The longer description in the server list.

variables.name: Server token
variables.description: The server token from play.eco (Account, Server Authentication, Generate token). Without one the server runs offline: unlisted, and players' accounts aren't checked.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: true lists the server in the in-game server browser.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once, or -1 for no limit.

variables.name: Category
variables.description: The category the server browser shows the server under.

variables.name: Playtime
variables.description: When people usually play, shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Discord
variables.description: A Discord invite shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: The server's language, such as English, French or German.

variables.name: Web port
variables.description: The TCP port of the server's web map and the client's world data. Give the server this port.

variables.name: Steam port
variables.description: The port Steam asks about the server on. Give the server this port.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: The port of the remote console. It needs no extra port unless you use RCON from outside.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The remote console's password, or empty to turn it off.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
